title: U.S. AI Adoption | Census Bureau BTOS Data | CrawlSpider
excerpt: Explore U.S. Census Bureau Business Trends and Outlook Survey (BTOS) data: AI adoption by state, biweekly trends, and detailed business AI survey results.
content_html:
U.S. CENSUS BUREAU / BUSINESS TRENDS AND OUTLOOK SURVEY

AI adoption.
Across America.

Where businesses are using artificial intelligence—and where they expect to use it next. Explore the states behind the numbers.

Loading Census estimates…

State estimates exclude the separate Census “XX” group for multi-unit companies operating across multiple sectors or states. Those companies are not assigned to an individual state in this download. Puerto Rico is outside this dashboard’s 50-state-and-D.C. view.

SOURCE & METHODOLOGY

Public data. Clear boundaries.

Source: U.S. Census Bureau, Business Trends and Outlook Survey (BTOS). Estimates describe employer businesses excluding farms—not households, workers, or all businesses. The national estimate is supplied by Census; it is not an average of the states.

Core estimates are released every two weeks. Detailed AI supplement questions are a separate fixed snapshot with question-specific populations. Suppressed values are never replaced with zero. Comparable core trends begin with the new wording released December 4, 2025.

BTOS methodology ↗

Independent visualization, not a Census Bureau product.
